description: DamWatch is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USEngineering Solutions Corporation; USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service. Stakeholders of NCRS-assisted dams can receive real-time updates of rainfall, snowmelt, stream flow, and seismic events that could affect dam safety. This monitoring software solution can assist with monitoring and managing NRCS-assisted dams. The tool helps dam owners to predict, identify, prepare for, manage, and record potentially destructive environmental events. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, Property, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
